updates.html: Design candidate. Source checked against Macro cf07e7a73334c646a09c043647c43e43ee6e4060. New product and recovery layouts extend the existing owners; this packet does not prove browser behavior, deployed capability or an issuer-to-trial join.

p6: 1K9 dark desktop, 1NN light desktop, 1R1 phone. p7: Aster 22G; Morrow 23C; Kestrel 248; Lumen 254; sources 260; source-version recovery 26W; English phone 27S; Chinese 320px recovery 29R. Existing R2 manual-save and recovery flow remains 171 on p4. Original selected-case and filter states remain on p3.
02 · Activation depends on real source identity

These four company cases and prices are fictional. Current BioCatalyst APIs serve ClinicalTrials.gov records; company-to-trial identity is unverified. Never infer NCT from a company name, ticker or visual card. Keep Save unavailable with “Trial link needed” until the existing owner supplies an exact eligible binding. Open trial research uses the existing BioCatalyst route and preserves the originating case.
03 · Selection and return remain one state

Extend the existing case selection and request controller. Carry selected case, active filter, view mode, scroll and invoker focus through case → sources → return. A filtered-out selected case is not automatically replaced. On phone, use a full case route; desktop uses the 620px detail surface. Back returns to the same investigation, with a focus fallback if its invoker no longer exists.

Route eligible records into existing currentSubject / ownerKeyFor / ownerStorage and MDXAuth. Preserve NCT, mode, exact row key, publication_ref and the separate local note ID. Typed reads distinguish empty, invalid, unavailable and restricted. Confirm only after matching write readback. An unverified write may already have succeeded: reconcile the original record before any retry. Saving creates no monitoring, alert or order.
05 · A changed version is not a changed outcome

Compare only within the same authenticated owner, NCT, mode and exact row. Changed publication_ref permits “Source version changed.” Field-level claims require both permitted versions and a real diff. The new 26W / 29R specimens show an unavailable earlier payload: retain its reference and original condition; explain why comparison is unavailable. Review condition opens R2 Edit without silently rebasing the save.

Aster separates trial result, company economics and illustrative price context, including the DAILY close below $39.60 condition. Morrow keeps company target timing separate from an actual regulatory decision. Kestrel separates gross financing, net cash and dilution. Lumen requires population, endpoint and safety comparison; a competitor result does not prove the company’s result. Missing clocks remain unavailable.

44px minimum actions; visible focus; title focus on entry; Escape/back returns to the exact invoker where possible. Desktop side panel must not hide its footer; long content scrolls inside the real route. Phone is a separate bounded case view, not a compressed four-report page. EN390 and ZH320 specimens establish readable wrapping. Light status text uses --mx-light-ink-up / ink-warn rather than low-contrast chart inks.

The existing illustrative series is retained with its exact example values; no new history, forecast or score was invented. Production display charts reuse lib/illus.py plus templates/illus.css and illus.js. Use the current ilx reveal once, settled static dot, and immediate final state for reduced motion. Panel entrance may use 180ms opacity + 8px translation; never pulse to imply live data.
09 · Build in this order; prove the real path

1. Verify the existing route and source identity contract. 2. Implement presentation and context return without changing owner storage. 3. Extend the existing publication reference and comparison path. 4. Wire eligible save to R2 and prove readback/recovery. Required checks: unjoined issuer, filtered selection, missing old version, restricted field, account change, failed readback, keyboard return, both themes, EN/ZH320. Existing release refusal remains binding; no release replay.

BUILD · INTRADAY R5 · 09 NOV 2026
One scan. One qualified basis.
Design candidate. Existing readers and classifier remain the owners. Native screens do not establish a historical snapshot service or prove deployed behavior.
Source pin · cf07e7a73334c646a09c043647c43e43ee6e4060

01 · Native routes and preserved source scope
Product p3: IK desktop light; MB desktop dark; OD phone EN; PO phone ZH; RY selected evidence; TF no current assessment; UP all six recorded classes. Original p1 source details CG / DX and reading guides FE / GN remain the named destinations. Original no-match 9F and loading AP remain distinct. The 5 / 111 counts and five named companies are captured design examples; the board-build time does not establish an evaluation time.

02 · One current evaluation, shared everywhere
Reuse templates/intraday_flow.html.j2: render → computeAll → computeLegs + computeStance → laneCounts and hero / spotlight / rows. Extend its current readers and state. Preserve activeBasket, activeStance, searchQ, groupByStance, openRows and boardExpanded. A selection changes the inspected company; Back restores the same filter, scroll and focus. Do not add a second classifier, refresh loop or return store.

03 · Recorded means a fixed basis
The current template recomputes from BASE_DATA plus mutable quoteState, pulseState and flowState. It does not expose an immutable recorded-assessment object. Activate a recorded runtime view only when the existing producer supplies an actual recorded result and qualified basis. Otherwise keep this as a dated design example. Current polling must not rewrite a recorded classification, its clocks or its evidence.

04 · Qualify source age separately from fetch coverage
fetchQuotes marks live at 90% finite-price coverage; fetchPulse at 80% bars_today coverage. Those paths do not qualify source age. Both merge dictionaries and retain older members after omission or failure. flowMetaFresh returns true outside its ET time window and accepts a future timestamp inside it. Extend the existing reader with verified source-clock/session and retained/current metadata; do not invent timestamp field names or a parallel freshness engine.

05 · Repair missingness and classifier parity
Source-verified differences need owner-led repair or accepted divergence before parity claims. JS L2/L3/L4/L6 can turn absent inputs into false while Python confluence_legs preserves None; JS L7 turns a known trap into null while Python yields false. JS also has L1 proxies and an L6 K fallback absent from Python. Valid zero volume and missing volume must stay distinct. New evidence specimens print “Not provided” because the original check values are not supplied.

06 · Coverage and options meanings stay separate
Expose the existing degraded / No read state: laneCounts currently omits it, so zero action counts do not prove a quiet or complete scan. Keep call-only minutes[].ncp and its durability distinct from tide net total calls+puts. Retain approximate direction labels, dealer context and Stop (nightly) as source-bound reference context. No composite confidence score, fabricated path or automatic trading meaning is added.

07 · State routing and exact return
Qualified zero matches uses existing no-match state; pending fetch uses loading; unusable required inputs use TF; partial coverage keeps readable rows with their own qualification. Refresh sources invokes the existing readers and inflight latches, not another poller. Clicking a classification updates the existing activeStance and returns to scan. Opening source/method details preserves the exact selected ticker and view context.

08 · Responsive and motion contract
The phone scan shows all five recorded candidates and sends detail to a separate route. Original method and source depth remains reachable. Actions are at least 44px, evidence values are readable, title focus and Escape/back restore the invoker. Panel entry may use 180ms opacity; reduced motion is immediate. Missing inputs use the static three-source illustration, never a made-up chart. Counts update atomically; no count-up animation for unavailable data.

09 · Build sequence and discriminating proof
First bind actual producer clocks and an eligible recorded basis. Next repair reader qualification and retained-member semantics. Then resolve Python/JS tri-state differences and degraded coverage in the existing owner. Finally wire the redesigned presentation and return path. Prove missing vs zero, known trap vs unknown, stale retained members, future/off-session timestamps, all-degraded rows, partial coverage, recorded/current isolation, same result across summary/list/detail, both themes and EN/ZH narrow layouts.

10 · Proposed qualification extends the existing owner
Recorded results require their own fixed basis from the existing producer. Current polling cannot silently replace that basis.
